rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A TypeScript server that provides complete access to Xiaomi's cloud-based note-taking service. Built by LaelLuo with automatic authentication handling, cookie management, and session persistence, it exposes tools for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes and folders, searching content, moving notes between folders, and uploading images with full metadata support. The implementation includes robust error handling, automatic login retry mechanisms, caching for performance optimization, and support for both manual and automatic authentication flows using service tokens and device credentials, making it useful for building AI assistants that can manage personal notes, automate note organization, or integrate Xiaomi Notes into broader productivity workflows.
